inspected_boundaries: The existing current compiled catalogue is the sole declaration index; all current source inputs and exact advertised names are checked before selection.
Mapping completeness is separated from execution, semantic correctness, and Python refinement.
Compiled proof dependencies, compiled type dependencies, static imports, authored family membership and shared operational routes have separate relation kinds.
Native binary presence is reported as NOT_RUN_BY_REUSE_REPORT, never as native verification.
Exact source headers are labelled separately from elaborated types; unsupported header syntax retains the exact source range and no invented premise list.
Code-owned entrypoint allowlist has no registry-supplied command and no shell; missing native programs do not select a Python fallback.
Python module entries resolve to local repository entry sources; native targets resolve to declared lake targets and current source files.
AGENTS and CLAUDE continuity instructions preserve the A116 and licensed progressive foundations and the open CertifiedBridge obligations.
The recursive source family preserves SOURCE_ONLY scope; source reconstruction is not claimed to recover the original syntactic derivation.
Data-only modules are distinguished from theorem-bearing modules; module completeness does not inflate theorem counts.

findings.original_issue: A Cartesian module-by-family-consumer edge population could suggest a verified use by every module.
findings.resolution: Graph changed to module-to-family membership and family-to-shared-route edges with an explicit shared-route scope.

findings.original_issue: Passing a negative child returncode to sys.exit changes POSIX signal termination into an unrelated ordinary exit code.
findings.resolution: The dispatcher propagates the actual terminating signal. A real separate-process SIGTERM fixture confirms stdout, stderr and returncode identity.

findings.original_issue: The selector reader could ignore an additional Make assignment overriding the literal default.
findings.resolution: Additional assignment forms are rejected; report scope explicitly uses the installed literal default rather than environment or Make overrides.

independently_executed_tests.output_provenance: Observed exec tool result; the full raw output was not separately retained as a file.

remaining_limits: 82 modules can be mapped without executing all 82. 1605 indexed declarations are not 1605 separately implemented semantic capabilities.
Authored shared routes identify intended existing consumers, not per-theorem dynamic execution or Python refinement proofs.
A catalogue/source hash match is not a fresh Lean compilation or independent source truth.
The source-only recursive adapter does not discharge all host licenses, grammarLicense, realizationAligned and RealizationContracts.
Direct existing proof-reference regeneration remains required when a stale current catalogue prevents use-map validation.
This review does not establish open-Arabic coverage, source authenticity, world correspondence, or agreement of human interpreters.
Full-suite results and remote CI are separate observations owned by the root validation process, not rerun or claimed by this reviewer.
